invented.quote: For larger groups, a basic scheduler that comes free with their records system is a real competitor.
invented.why: The brief says the lost customer moved to the scheduler built into their electronic records system, not that the built-in scheduler is basic or comes free.

invented.quote: It also works no matter which scheduler a clinic uses.
invented.why: The brief says the reminder feature will be sold on its own next month, not that it works with any scheduler.

invented.quote: This lets us sell to clinics that are committed to their records system's scheduler, including groups like the chain we just lost, without having to replace that scheduler.
invented.why: The brief does not state that the standalone reminder feature can be used alongside a records system's scheduler without replacing it.
